BL-873 — DEFECT — one botched documenter insertion wedged 286 copies of the same paragraph through the last third of Specification.MD, 284 of them carrying a quote-mangled command example, and nothing in the tree looks for repeated documentation prose
What it solves: The acceptance contract ships as `.feature.draft` (BL-233): its step handlers
do not exist yet, and a live `*.feature` with no handlers makes the acceptance
runner throw. The coder renames it to `.feature` and updates this ticket's
`acceptance:` field in the same parcel that lands the handlers.
Approval context: New feature draft needs review, plus two calls to sign off or overturn. (1) Severity is deliberately medium, not high — nothing is broken at runtime, no gate fails, and the swarm operates normally; the cost is ~825 KB of duplicate prose in a document project.prompt tells agents to read, plus a wron…
BL-873 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-873" (or "reject BL-873 <reason>") to act.
